name: deowan-homeo-clinic
description: Full-Stack Web Application for দেওয়ান হোমিও ক্লিনিক (Deowan Homeo Clinic)

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client
scripts.build: npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.build:render: npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server && npm run prisma:push --prefix server && npm run prisma:seed --prefix server

author: Deowan Homeo Clinic
